introHtml: Orange badge reels offer high visibility for your team, making it easy to spot staff at trade shows, events, or job sites. Whether you choose neon shades for maximum impact or a subtle orange for brand consistency, these reels keep IDs accessible and secure. Decorate with your logo using pad printing, screen printing, or direct digital printing. Perfect for safety managers and marketing directors who want both function and brand exposure.
